subject: Gatekeeper integration: evidence exchange & pen-test orchestration
messages:
From: Marta Ruiz <marta.ruiz@gatekeeper-sys.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Cc: Gatekeeper Security Ops <secops@gatekeeper-sys.com>
Date: 2026-10-12T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Intro: Gatekeeper x Redwood — evidence sharing & pen test sync

Hi Neha,

Thanks for taking this on — we had a brief exec sync and Gatekeeper is ready to move ahead with the technical integration for evidence exchange ahead of our joint pen test in November. High-level asks from our side:

- Define a secure handoff path for SOC2 artifacts (SFTP vs API push) and redaction expectations.
- Align on timeline for evidence staging (we aim to hand over a scoped bundle by 2026-11-01).
- Coordinate the pen test window and the scope owner at Redwood for access during testing.

I've attached a first-pass scope doc (gatekeeper-scope-v1.pdf) and an onboarding checklist. Can we do a quick 30-min call this week to confirm?

Attachments: gatekeeper-scope-v1.pdf (PDF, 125KB)

Thanks,
Marta Ruiz
Partnerships & Integrations
Gatekeeper Systems
+marta.ruiz@gatekeeper-sys.com

From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Marta Ruiz <marta.ruiz@gatekeeper-sys.com>
Cc: Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-12T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Intro: Gatekeeper x Redwood — evidence sharing & pen test sync

Marta — thanks and welcome.

Short answers and proposed plan:

1) Handoff method: we prefer a short-lived, audited SFTP drop for artifacts plus an API-based manifest callback for automation. If Gatekeeper requires push-only, we can provide a TLS-protected API endpoint with mTLS. Please confirm which you prefer.

2) Redaction: Redwood requires removal of any PII from artifacts before ingestion. We'll provide a redaction checklist; see attached "evidence-handoff-instructions.docx" for our minimum fields to redact.

3) Timeline & owners:
   - Evidence staging by 2026-11-01 — Gatekeeper to upload to our staging SFTP.
   - Pen test window: Redwood Ops suggests 2026-11-08 through 2026-11-12. Sergio, can you confirm resource availability?
   - Internal owner: Lauren will be the point for evidence intake and validation.

Can we do 30 minutes tomorrow at 10:00 PT? If that works, I'll send a calendar invite and a short agenda (handoff method, redaction, timeline, access controls).

Attachments: evidence-handoff-instructions.docx (DOCX, 42KB)

Best,
Neha Kapoor
Head of Partner Security Programs
Redwood Inference
neha.kapoor@redwood.com

From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, Marta Ruiz <marta.ruiz@gatekeeper-sys.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-13T08:27:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Intro: Gatekeeper x Redwood — evidence sharing & pen test sync

Neha / Marta — quick note from infra side.

We can support either workflow but recommend the SFTP staging + API manifest approach for three reasons: auditability, simple re-run for missing artifacts, and lower onboarding friction for Gatekeeper's engineering. A few operational bullets:

- Staging bucket will be ephemeral (7 days retention) unless an exception is approved.
- Files will be hashed on ingest; we'll return a manifest with SHA256 checksums.
- For pen test access, we require scoped SSH keys and timebound accounts; no shared accounts. Please provide a primary contact for key exchange.

Lauren — I'll hand the intake checklist to you after the call. Neha, I can confirm infra coverage for 2026-11-08 to 2026-11-12 but would like a freeze window (no infra deploys) 24 hours before the start.

On the call agenda, I'd add: acceptance criteria for evidence completeness and rollback process if redaction issues are found.

— Sergio
Director, Security Engineering
Redwood Inference
sergio_alvarez@redwood.com

From: Marta Ruiz <marta.ruiz@gatekeeper-sys.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-15T16:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Intro: Gatekeeper x Redwood — evidence sharing & pen test sync

Thanks everyone — call confirmed for 2026-10-14 10:00 PT (we'll use Zoom). Quick confirmations before we meet:

- Gatekeeper prefers the SFTP staging + manifest flow. We'll prepare the upload bundle and follow the redaction checklist.
- Primary contact for key exchange: Jose Alvarez (jose.alvarez@gatekeeper-sys.com). He will send an SSH pubkey and point-of-contact details by 2026-10-13 EOD.
- We'll sign the one-way MOU for evidence handling today and send via DocuSign (DOCUSIGN-12345).

Action items:
- Gatekeeper: upload keys + final scope doc (Marta) — by 2026-10-13 EOD.
- Redwood: send calendar invite and staging SFTP credentials (Neha / Sergio) — by 2026-10-13 EOD.
- Redwood: provide redaction checklist and acceptance criteria on the call (Lauren).

Looking forward to the sync.

Attachments referenced: gatekeeper-scope-v1.pdf
DocuSign: DOCUSIGN-12345

Best,
